prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
If you mean **spray tanning**, **Sun Studio Tan** in the Short North is a strong pick: it has positive reports for natural-looking results and a comfortable experience, and offers online booking at **612 N. High St.** ([website](https://www.sunstudiotan.com/), **614-333-0051**).

For a more personalized, appointment-based spray tan, **Mahalo Spray Tanning** is another well-reviewed option at **55 Dillmont Dr.** ([Yelp](https://www.yelp.com/biz/mahalo-spray-tanning-columbus-2)).

“Best” depends on whether you want spray or UV tanning and what part of Columbus you’re in. For UV tanning, check the specific salon’s equipment, cleanliness, and safety practices before booking.
